seo.title: Manage Every Branch on Google Maps in One Place | SAAYT
seo.description: Update hours · photos and details for all your branches on Google at once and handle reviews with dialect-aware reply drafts your team approves

hero.sub: SAAYT keeps every branch on Google to the same standard from one screen: hours, photos, details and a reply to every review
hero.note: Nothing is published without your approval

heroCard.label: Example
heroCard.review: Great service but I waited a long time at the cashier and the staff didn’t know about the offer
heroCard.suggested: Suggested reply in the customer’s tone
heroCard.reply: Thank you for the feedback about our Olaya branch. We’re sorry about the wait at the cashier and we’ve asked the branch manager to follow up. We hope to see you again soon

trust: Nothing goes live without your approval
Arabic first in your customer’s dialect
Made for branch chains in Saudi Arabia

problem.h2: Every branch speaks in a different voice
problem.lead: The more branches you run the more small mistakes customers see before they visit: old hours in one branch, an old photo in another and a review nobody answered

pains.d: Updated in one branch and outdated in the rest so customers arrive at a closed door
A negative review in a far branch that nobody noticed for days
An old phone number, photos that don’t look like the store and the wrong category

concept.h2: One star that brings every branch together
concept.lead: In the SAAYT identity each branch is a point and the star is the standard that connects them. That is what SAAYT does: every branch behaves like one brand

points.d: Every branch and its status on one screen
Change it once and it reaches every selected branch
Replies that sound like your brand in your customer’s dialect
The same level in every branch and every city

steps.d: Connect your branches’ Business Profiles with your permission and see every branch in one dashboard
SAAYT sorts your priorities: an unanswered review, missing hours or changed details

steps.t: Approve and it reaches every branch
steps.d: Approve the reply or the change in one click and apply it to one branch or all of them

features.h2: Everything customers see about your branches in one place

hours.h: Ramadan and Eid for every branch in one edit
hours.d: Prepare season and holiday hours from ready templates and apply them to the branches you choose before the season starts
bullets: Ramadan, Eid, National Day and Founding Day templates
Two shifts a day per branch
Alerts for branches missing season hours

reviews.h: No review left without a reply
reviews.d: Every branch review in one inbox with a suggested reply in the customer’s dialect that your team reviews and approves before it posts
bullets: Replies in Saudi dialect, formal Arabic or English
Nothing posts before a person on your team approves
One consistent brand tone across branches

alerts.h: Know which branch needs you today
alerts.d: Get alerted when a low rating lands or a number or hours change on Google and see one clear score per branch to compare them
bullets: A score per branch with the method explained

details.h: Correct details and photos in every branch
details.d: Keep names, categories, contact numbers and photos consistent across branches so customers always see current information
bullets: Reminders when branch photos get old
Track any change made to a branch profile

industries.h2: Made for branch chains in Saudi Arabia
industries.lead: Every industry has its own seasons, customer questions and way of replying and we start from yours

scan.h2: When did you last check your branches on Google?
scan.lead: A two-minute self-check that ranks the priorities for each branch: hours, details, photos and reviews. No sign-up and we never read your data

principles.h2: Built on the trust of your team and your customers

items.d: SAAYT suggests and you decide. No reply or change goes live on Google without approval from someone on your team
The product and the replies are written Arabic first and understand your customers’ dialects across the Kingdom and the Gulf
Ramadan, Eid, National Day and Founding Day are part of the system, not an add-on
We use Google data only to manage your branches and follow Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law

items.a: No. SAAYT suggests a reply in the customer’s dialect and it waits for approval from someone on your team. You can edit it or reject it before anything is posted

items.q: What do I need to start?
items.a: The Google account that manages your branches’ Business Profiles. Once connected every branch appears in one dashboard

items.q: Does it work if I only have two or three branches?
items.a: SAAYT is designed for chains of 5 branches or more but you can start with any number and we’ll find the right plan together

items.q: How do you handle Ramadan and Eid hours?
items.a: You set up the season template once and apply it to the branches you choose. SAAYT alerts you to branches that are missing season hours

items.q: Can the SAAYT team manage the branches for me?
items.a: Yes. An optional managed service lets the SAAYT team handle monitoring and replies on your behalf while you stay in control
No. SAAYT is an independent Saudi platform that connects to your branch profiles on Google with your permission and you can disconnect at any time

final.h2: Keep every branch to the same standard
final.lead: Book a demo with the SAAYT team and we’ll show you how your branches look on Google and how to run them all from one screen
